description: Business-level reads with a system user token holding `business_management` (live, 2026-11-18, v23.0). GET /{Business-ID}/owned_whatsapp_business_accounts returned each account as `{ id, name, timezone_id, message_template_namespace }`; WhatsAppBusinessAccount has no `message_template_namespace`, the namespace Meta's docs list as a WhatsApp Business Account field. GET /{WABA-ID}/assigned_users returned each user as `{ id, name, tasks: ["MANAGE"] }`; AssignedUser has no `tasks`. Both are added as optional.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: Namespace of the account's message templates.
Tasks the user can perform on the asset, e.g. `MANAGE`.
